findings.title: The Electrical Test field is not specified: JLC's free default is a random-sample flying-probe test, while owner row 29 relies on every bare board being tested

evidence.docs: ORDERING 8.1 'Electrical test' row: 'Keep JLC's bare-board electrical (open / short) test, and confirm it in the order ... That JLC tests every four-layer bare board by default is also an Inference.' The same reliance is in M3_R10.md 'Power' (Mitigations: JLC's electrical test of the bare board) and R10_VALIDATION owner row 29.
evidence.jlc_live: JLC order form https://cart.jlcpcb.com/quote (read 2026-11-01): Electrical Test options 'Flying Probe Fully Test'; 'Full Test: 100% pass rate, but is slower and incurs a fee due to it is time-consuming.'; 'Random Test: Free of charge, ensuring a minimum pass rate of 99%.'; 'E-test Fixture'.
evidence.board: EN chain U9.1 -> via (17.10, 82.80) -> R81 / C87 (D-R21-05); one open via floats EN 0.2 mm from BAT_IN (R21-SAF-01, Inference).

findings.impact: The docs give no single value for this field. If the free option is taken, a given bare board may not be tested, so the first screen for an open in the EN via (owner row 29) is not assured on every board. The per-flight 'off with J400 open' check is still the second screen, so this is a procedure gap, not a fire path.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. ORDERING 8.1: 'Electrical Test: Flying Probe Full Test (fee; include it in the quote)'. Replace the 'tests every four-layer bare board by default' Inference with the form's wording and date. Make owner row 29 and M3_R10 'Mitigations' name the Full Test.

findings.title: Order-number mark: JLC withdrew the order number in May 2026 and asks for no JLCJLCJLCJLC text, but the board carries the placeholder and ORDERING says 'Specify a location'

evidence.board: B.Silkscreen text 'JLCJLCJLCJLC', mirrored, at KiCad (20.35, 35.6), 1.0 / 0.15 mm; Gerber ink x 15.323-25.425, y 34.980-36.130 (re-measured; matches ORDERING 8.1). Required by m3_design/r10_post.py (item 3) and tools/check_r10.py JLC_ORDER_MARK.
evidence.docs: ORDERING 8.1 'Order-number mark (R20-MFG-04)': choose 'Specify a location' for the order number.
evidence.jlc_live: https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/How-to-mark-on-PCB (last updated 2026-05-22, read 2026-11-01): 'Order Number is not available since May 2026'; 'Please DO NOT add "JLCJLCJLCJLC" in your silkscreen layer for specifying order number location'; 'No mark will be added on the PCB by default'; 'Specify Position' now needs a solid silkscreen square (2 x 10 mm for a number, 5/8/10 mm for a 2D barcode). The quote page (read 2026-11-01) lists Mark on PCB: Order Number, 2D barcode, Remove Mark, with 'No mark will be added by default'.

findings.impact: The documented form value is no longer a JLC process. The 12-character text will either be printed literally on the bottom or raise an engineering query. No electrical or assembly effect.
findings.concrete_fix: Text now: ORDERING 8.1, 'Mark on PCB: none (default) / Remove Mark'. Add a remark that the bottom text 'JLCJLCJLCJLC' at Gerber (20.35, -35.6) is a legacy legend and may be printed as-is or omitted, then confirm in Confirm Production File. At the next board change: delete the placeholder and drop the requirement from r10_post / check_r10 (or replace it with a solid square if a 2D serial is wanted).

findings.title: Section 8 does not give one value for several JLC PCB / SMT form fields; sections 3-4 (R9) are excluded unless restated

evidence.docs: ORDERING section 8 intro: use sections 1-7's procedures 'only where restated here'. Fields with no R10 value: Delivery Format; edge-rail sides and width; Via Covering (8.1 says 'plugged only where ... permit; otherwise tent', which is not a form option); Tooling holes; fiducials; Silkscreen colour; Product Type; panel or rail removal by JLC; ENIG thickness.
evidence.jlc_live: Quote page (read 2026-11-01): Delivery Format 'Single PCB / Panel by Customer / Panel by JLCPCB - We construct your panel with v-cut'; Silkscreen white by default; Product Type Aerospace/Medical 'require 4-Wire Kelvin Test ... and FR4 Tg155 for 4- and 6-layer'. Assembly capabilities https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-assembly-capabilities (read 2026-11-01): Standard single PCB 70x70 to 460x500 mm, edge rails and fiducials 'Necessary', 'Wave soldering is used for THT', 'Panel removal is available as an option'. Assembly terms https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/61-Terms-and-Conditions-of-JLCPCB-Assembly-Service (updated 2026-09-09): §5.5 'Tooling holes, Edge rails and Fiducials are required', added by default; §5.14 for boards under 70 x 70 mm JLC 'will select a suitable production method for edge rail, for instance, mouse bite method'.
evidence.board: No fiducials and no tooling holes on the board (pcbnew footprint scan). Width 46 mm, so a long-edge rail panel needs about 12 mm per side (rail plus gap) to reach JLC's 70 mm Standard minimum. Of the 300 vias, 179 are within 0.35 mm (pad edge) of a solder-mask opening on at least one side (62 F, 144 B), so JLC cannot ink-plug them (Gerber measurement); no ordinary via's drill wall is within 0.10 mm of an opening.

findings.impact: An operator filling in the form must guess, or copy R9's section 3/4 values, which section 8 forbids. The risks: 'Panel by JLCPCB' gives V-cut, which J3's overhang forbids; JLC removing the rails conflicts with 8.3's 'nibble, never snap'; Aerospace product type adds cost and test changes; the via-covering selection is not fixed.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. Add an 'R10 order form' table to 8.1 / 8.2, one value per field: Base FR-4; 4 layers; 1.6 mm; Product Type Industrial/Consumer; Delivery Format Single PCB with JLC-added edge rails on the two long edges (tab-routed, per the tab plan, about 12 mm rails to reach 70 mm; confirm in Confirm Production File); green mask; white silkscreen; ENIG (default thickness); outer 1 oz / inner 1 oz; stackup JLC041611-7628; Via Covering Plugged (unpluggable vias tented) with the U401 VIPPO remark, or Epoxy Filled & Capped under VIPPO fallback (1); Min via 0.3 / 0.5 mm (no surcharge, per the form note); Mark on PCB none; Electrical Test Flying Probe Full Test; Confirm Production File yes. Assembly: Standard; both sides; tooling holes and fiducials added by JLCPCB; Confirm Parts Placement yes; no panel removal (owner nibbles the tabs).

findings.title: VIPPO request: JLC's help says filled vias can be named per via; the docs cite only the capabilities page, and the paste windows overlap the via drills if the fill is missed

evidence.jlc_live: https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-via-covering (read 2026-11-01): Epoxy / Copper filled & capped, holes 'should not exceed 0.5 mm'; 'specify which vias to fill with a note or image, or fill all vias of a given diameter'; resin filling is free only for 6-layer and above. https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (read 2026-11-01): filled & capped for 0.15-0.55 mm vias, default only for 6+ layers.
evidence.docs: ORDERING 8.1 'Via covering and the VIPPO fallback': JLC 'may refuse per-via mixing, apply the option to every via ... or silently ignore it'.
evidence.board: Both U401.11 vias, (27.3, 13.6) / (27.9, 13.6), 0.5 / 0.3 mm, filling = 1, capping = 1 (pcbnew); they are in the PTH.drl T1 0.300 mm group with 297 other vias, so 'by diameter' means every 0.3 mm via. B.Paste windows 1.13 x 0.89 mm at y 13.045 and 14.155: the gap between them is 0.22 mm, so each window overlaps the 0.30 mm drill outline by 0.04 mm and the 0.5 mm land by 0.14 mm. The BAT_IN via drill is 0.5 mm, within JLC's 0.5 mm fill limit.

findings.impact: The docs' fallback reasoning is less certain than JLC's own text: the per-via route exists, but only by note or image. If the fill is missed, paste sits over the edge of open barrels and can wick from U401's exposed pad. That is an assembly-yield and thermal residual already covered as an Inference.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. In 8.1 / 8.2, cite the via-covering help article. Attach an image or coordinate list of the two vias to the order remark. State that 'fill by diameter' equals the whole-board fill (fallback 1). Add first-article X-ray of U401 pad 11 voiding and wicking (JLC X-rays QFN / LGA automatically, per the assembly capabilities page).

findings.title: Parts nearer than JLC's 2.5 mm body-to-edge assembly rule on the rail-less short edges are not in the expected DFM queries

evidence.jlc_live: Assembly terms §2.3 (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/61-Terms-and-Conditions-of-JLCPCB-Assembly-Service, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-01): 'The distance between the body of the components and the edge of the board must be equal or greater than 2.5mm.'
evidence.board: Courtyard to edge (pcbnew), mm: aft y=0: R400 / R401 / R404 1.02, C403 1.96; forward y=90: C95 1.50, R92 1.72, R166 1.75, TP88 1.95; west: J3 -1.03 (overhang), J2 1.46; east: TP74 2.45. The 8.1 tab plan puts rails and tabs on the long edges only.
evidence.docs: ORDERING 8.2 'Expected DFM queries' lists U11, J3, U4 webs, via covering, VIPPO, C84 and the M3 holes, but not edge clearance.

findings.impact: JLC may query, or add rails on the short edges, which would change the agreed tab plan (the T-1 short-edge windows are narrow). This is a planning gap; parts on non-rail edges are normally accepted.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. Add to 'Expected DFM queries' and the remark: rails on the two long edges only, and the short-edge parts R400 / R401 / R404 (1.02 mm), C95, R92, R166, C403, TP88 sit less than 2.5 mm from the aft / forward edges by design. If JLC insists on four-side rails, re-run T-1 for short-edge tabs before accepting.

coverage_limits: The quote page was read as text only: no Gerber upload, DFM, quote, rail preview or production-file check was made, and its via-covering and assembly sub-fields were not visible.
JLC's stackup images were not readable. The JLC041611-7628 values come from a third-party mirror (Inference).
Drill tolerance and milling tolerance are not modelled beyond the +/-0.2 mm statement.
Bare via barrels on inner layers (no ring) are not in the Gerbers, so the inner clearance to them was not measured from the Gerbers (D-R21-01's own record covers them).
The check-code changes in D-R22 were not re-run or seeded (gate lens). Only fab-content equality was verified.
Supplier stock and cost were not re-queried.
Round 22's manufacturing report was read after these findings were written; it had none of R23-MANUFACTURING-01 to -05. It noted the missing fiducial line as optional, which overlaps part of -03.
